reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is deconvolving the observed event stream E = X * C, where C are true campaign contributions. This is an underdetermined inverse problem. We introduce prior structure P(C) to regularize, yielding the posterior P(C|E,X) ∝ P(E|X,C)P(C). For conjugate priors on C, the posterior mean provides a point estimate. In GSE, we use a Dirichlet prior to enforce contribution sum-to-one constraints, while GSI uses a robust Student-t likelihood to downweight outlier campaigns. Both systems rely on variational inference to scale to high-dimensional X.
